saw_lines: Olive oil buyers want to know the bottle arrives intact, then they reorder, so one bad delivery ends the account.
So the sale is lost when a buyer cannot see how the bottle is packed or how long delivery takes.
Your site shows 152 reviews, yet only 1 of 30 ads carries any proof number, so put 152 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 152 reviews, yet only 1 of 30 ads carries a proof number, buried in the link text. New buyers need it in line one. Put 152 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

Your site explains how the order arrives, but 0 of 30 ads do. Gift buyers hesitate without a picture of the box. Show a packed hamper arriving at a door in one video ad, and name the delivery window in the first line.
28 ads have run 60 days or more, so they hold up, yet your newest ads reuse none of their opening lines. Build three variations of the January Ellidy body oil ad, each with a new first line.

15 different openings run across 20 copy ads, and the biggest leads only 3 of them, so no story sticks. Pick two stories, the Ellidy restock and the Firming Elixir glow, and make the next batch from them.
